fields.description: Selected genders (e.g. Women, Men, Kids) — brand-scoped free values, no master. JSON array.

fields.description: Surplus stock recommendations (prism.api.surplus_recommender.recommend). Replaced wholesale on every sync_surplus_fabrics — a disposable snapshot of what the recommender returned, with the user's picks flagged.

fields.description: User-generated recoloured swatches, joined to the above by fab_code. Deliberately a SIBLING table, not part of the recommendation row: re-running the recommender replaces surplus_fabrics wholesale, and these assets must survive that.
fields.label: Surplus Recolours

fields.description: Internal working material — deliberately stripped from published_snapshot, so none of it reaches brand users (see moodboard_v2._SNAPSHOT_INTERNAL_KEYS).

fields.description: Free keywords describing the board. JSON array of strings.
fields.label: Keywords

fields.description: Key insights as key/value pairs. JSON object.
fields.label: Key Insights

fields.description: Fabric direction. Free-form JSON until the schema settles (same holding pattern as addons).
fields.label: Fabric Direction

fields.description: Matched garments from prism.api.garment_matching.match_garments, stored verbatim (id, brand, productName, category, ..., matchRationale) — richer and more variable in shape than a fixed child-table row would allow.

fields.description: Derived signals for the garment direction (free-form JSON, shape not fixed yet).

fields.description: Derived signals for the print direction (free-form JSON, shape not fixed yet).

fields.description: Full WGSN alignment report snapshot (score, summary, matched/missed trends, palette, generated_at).
fields.label: Alignment Report

fields.description: Prints / embroideries / aops + techniques. Parked as JSON until the schema is finalised.
fields.label: Addons

fields.description: Frozen snapshot of the normalized board captured at publish. Brand-facing reads return this.
